_description: Ground truth for cypher-semantics regression fixture. Floors are minimum acceptable values; the extractor may add to these. See README.md and check_cypher_semantics.py for the assertions.
_note_on_param_types: param_types is not exercised here because the Rust extractor only emits it for path-qualified types (e.g. iroh::Endpoint, Arc<T>). Bare primitives like String do not trigger param_types emission. The element-of CONTAINS operator on array properties is sufficiently covered by `decorators` and `return_types` below.
